title: IranSeda Corpus Record v1.0
description: One actual radio program session of the IranSeda archive, with all transcript artifacts. Identity policy (Stage 1, IRANSEDA-CORPUS-2026-01): radio_program_sessions.id (database_refs.session_id) is the authoritative session identity; episode_key (ch,e) is a source reference, never sole identity; records colliding on (ch,e) stay quarantined (quarantine.jsonl) until identity is proven. Original content is never replaced by corrected content; every version is preserved as a separate entry. Fields without a verified source are null + missing_reason, never guessed. Broadcast dates come from the canonical filename (Jalali, 5-token stem JJ-MM-DD-HH-MM, year prefix 14) and are converted to Gregorian with a pinned conversion; archive-insert time (created_at) is never used as broadcast date. Server-private paths and secrets are forbidden everywhere in the record.

x-corpus.record_granularity: one record per actual session (radio_program_sessions.id); identical archive links are NEVER collapsed

record_id.description: Stable, extraction-order-independent INDEX key (not identity). Preferred: iranseda:ch{ch}:e{e} from the canonical audio link. Fallback (no e= id): iranseda:db{program_id}:s{session_id} — always unique because it includes session_id. Sessions that share a (ch,e) with another session: only one keeps the ch:e id, the rest fall back and are quarantined until identity is proven (Stage 1 policy).

episode_key.description: Canonical external episode SOURCE REFERENCE (EPG slot). Not session identity — several sessions may share the same (ch, e).

ch.description: Channel id from program/episode URL (e.g. 14 = Radio Maaref).

e.description: Numeric EPG episode id from the audio link (?e=...), kept as string to preserve digits.

m.description: 6-digit program id from the program page URL (?m=...).

database_refs.description: Traceability back to the live DB. database_refs.session_id (radio_program_sessions.id, PK) is the AUTHORITATIVE session identity per Stage 1.

program_id.description: radio_program_sessions.program_id (the row actually referenced by the session).

program_ids_all.description: All radio_programs rows sharing the same (ch,m) — legacy + current duplicates.

llm_output.description: All llm_output.id rows attached (all job_types, all models).

program.description: Merged program info (legacy + current rows merged on (ch,m)).

name_raw.description: Original DB value (recoverable original, per normalization rule).

url.description: Canonical program page URL with ch and m.

radio.description: Radio name (legacy rows may be empty).

schedule.description: The program's BROADCAST SCHEDULE (when the program airs) — NOT the air time of this episode. Schedule and episode time are kept separate by design.

broadcast.description: WHEN THIS EPISODE AIREDS. Parsed from the canonical filename stem radio-<chan>-JJ-MM-DD-HH-MM (5 numeric tokens, seconds implicitly 00; year = 14JJ — erratum 2026-11-04), NEVER from created_at (crawl/insert time). null when no filename exists (342 such sessions) with quality.missing+=broadcast.date.

date.description: Jalali date YYYY-MM-DD (year completed from 2-digit stem, prefix 14; 2-digit values that parse to an impossible future year are flagged, never silently 'fixed').
Derived by Jalali→Gregorian conversion (must agree with the jalali date; validator recomputes).

conversion.description: Library + version used for the conversion.

filename_stem.description: The exact stem the broadcast date was parsed from (auditability).

url.description: Absolute audio URL (session.link resolved against https://radio.iranseda.ir/).

link_raw.description: Original relative link value from the DB.

filename.description: DB session.filename (audio file name on the server).

local_exists.description: True if the audio file was found on the export host at build time (informational; paths are NOT embedded in the corpus).

speakers.description: ONLY from verified crawled sources. Currently: no source table exists in the DB — speakers is always an empty list with missing_reason. Never guessed from ASR text.

missing_reason.description: e.g. 'no verified source table in database (stage-1 finding #9)'.

transcripts.description: ALL transcript artifacts. Originals and corrections are independent entries; an original is never replaced by a corrected version.

llm_outputs.description: One entry per llm_output row (per job_type per model). All versions preserved.

content.description: NFC-normalized. corrected text / bilingual summary / full text.

srt_content.description: Corrected SRT (job_type=correct_subtitles); must parse as SRT.

file_relpath.description: Server-relative artifact path from the DB (not an absolute/private path).

asr_outputs.description: Rows from asr_output (provider registry). Empty for the overwhelming majority — production Whisper outputs are NOT registered in that table; provenance is stated, not invented.

whisper_provenance.description: Honest statement about the unregistered Whisper path.

provider.description: e.g. 'whisper (local pipeline, output not registered in asr_output)'.

source_metadata.description: How to find everything on the public web.

export_version.description: Corpus build id (git SHA or timestamped run id).

session_created_at.description: DB crawl/insert time (NOT broadcast time). Kept for audit.

quality.description: Explicit missing-data status — no silent gaps.

exists.description: Artifact present (DB reference or on-disk file at build time).

relpath.description: Server-relative path (downloads/...), never an absolute private path.

content.description: NFC-normalized full content when inlined (see build config).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the inlined content (or file when hashed).

duration_sec.description: Last SRT cue end time, in seconds.
